# VinSnapshot

> Free, no-signup VIN decoder tools. Each tool decodes a 17-character
> Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) using the U.S. National Highway
> Traffic Safety Administration's public vPIC database and returns
> factory-build data: make, model, model year, body style, engine,
> fuel type, drive type, transmission, and assembly plant location.

VinSnapshot provides brand-specific VIN decoder pages for 25 major car
and motorcycle brands sold in the US. Each page is a free browser-based
tool — no account, no payment, no API key, no daily limit. Results come
directly from NHTSA's public vPIC dataset and reflect original factory
specifications only.

## Scope and limitations

These tools decode factory build data only, sourced from NHTSA's public
vPIC database, which covers vehicles manufactured or imported for the
US market. They do NOT provide vehicle history, accident records,
title status, ownership history, or recall notices. For recalls, use
NHTSA's official recall lookup. For accident and title history, use a
dedicated vehicle history report service.

## About

VinSnapshot is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed
by, or sponsored by any vehicle manufacturer named above, or by the
National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
